payload.abstract: MIMIC-III is a database of critically ill patients admitted to an intensive care unit (ICU) at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) in Boston, MA. MIMIC-III has seen broad use, and was updated with the release of MIMIC-IV. MIMIC-IV contains more contemporaneous stays, higher granularity data, and expanded domains of information. To maximize the sample size of MIMIC-IV, the database overlaps with MIMIC-III, and specifically both databases contain the same admissions which occurred between 2008 - 2012. This overlap complicates analyses of the two databases simultaneously. Here we provide a subset of MIMIC-III containing patients who are not in MIMIC-IV. The goal of this project is to simplify the combination of MIMIC-III with MIMIC-IV.
